description: This file appears to be a Perl module implementing the Git::SVN package, which integrates Git and Subversion repositories. It contains numerous subroutines and package variables related to repository management, revision handling, and properties associated with SVN and Git, including methods for fetch, revision mapping, configuration, and metadata management.

classes.name: Git::SVN
classes.description: Main class representing a Git::SVN repository instance, encompassing revision mapping, configuration, and repository operations.

methods.name: mkfile
methods.description: Creates a new file at the specified path if it doesn't already exist, ensuring the directory structure is created.

methods.name: use_fsync
methods.description: Determines if file synchronization (fsync) should be used based on environment settings and configuration.

methods.name: rev_map_set
methods.description: Sets a mapping from a revision to a commit hash in the revision map database with optional reference update and UUID.

methods.name: rev_map_max
methods.description: Returns the maximum revision and commit, rebuilding the map if necessary.

methods.name: rev_map_max_norebuild
methods.description: Retrieves maximum revision and commit without rebuilding the revision map, reading from the revision map file.

methods.name: rev_map_get
methods.description: Fetches the commit hash associated with a given revision number and UUID from the revision map.

methods.name: _rev_map_get
methods.description: Internal method implementing binary search over the revision map file to retrieve commit hash for a revision.

methods.name: find_rev_before
methods.description: Finds the first SVN revision that exists on or before a specified revision, not lower than min_rev.

methods.name: find_rev_after
methods.description: Finds the first SVN revision that exists on or after a specified revision, not higher than max_rev.

methods.name: _new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Git::SVN object with specified repository ID, ref ID, and path, initializing directory structure.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Getter/setter for the object's canonicalized file path.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Getter/setter for the object's URL, canonicalized.

methods.name: unlink_rev_db_symlink
methods.description: Removes the symbolic link for the revision database if it exists.

methods.name: rev_db_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the revision database for a given UUID.

methods.name: map_path
methods.description: Constructs the file path for the revision map database, optionally for a specific UUID.

methods.name: uri_encode
methods.description: Encodes a string to be URI-safe by percent-encoding special characters.

methods.name: uri_decode
methods.description: Decodes a URI-encoded string back to its original form.

methods.name: remove_username
methods.description: Strips username information from a URL.
